grades: Apply in 10th grade; programs run grades 11 and 12
pay_detail: Part of your regular school day. No cost stated.
name: Shared-Time Career Programs (grades 11 and 12)
what_you_do: In junior and senior year, spend half of each school day in a hands-on shop. Choices include carpentry, electrical, welding, HVAC, auto repair, hair and nails, cooking or game design.
who_can_apply: 10th graders. The page gives no acceptance criteria for shared-time programs and refers to a separate admissions procedures page. The page says no RSVP is required for the information sessions. Your home district provides transportation.
deadline_text: The 2027-2028 application is open now. No closing date is posted on the page. Info sessions: Oct 29, Nov 19, Dec 9 and Dec 16, 2026 and Jan 11, 2027.
how_to_apply: Make an account in the online application portal and fill in the form. Your school counselor then sends your grades and attendance. Email admissions@mcts.edu with questions.
notes: Students in a shared-time program cannot also do Career Prep. Ask your counselor for the deadline. Programs are at the Assunpink Center (Trenton) and the Sypek Center (Pennington).
